title: Practice 1: The family of пасть (попа́сть, упа́сть)

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **падёт** — пасть (perfective): (dated, literary) to fall; (of а decision, especially by lot) to fall on an option; (figurative, high register) to fall, to die on the battlefield, to be killed in action; (figurative, formal, of historical states, governments) to fall, to lose power, to cease to exist, to be toppled.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
